name: Moixent (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above and yellow below, charged at the upper hoist with a yellow castle.
history: The official flag of Moixent is of proportions 2:3, divided per bend sinister; it was approved by resolution of 31 May 2001 of the Conseller of Justice and Public Administrations and published in the DOGV. The arms had been published in the DOGV of 19 November 1979 and modified by resolution of 2 February 1993.
